contract: stake set for a round: tag 0x2e plus set pointer at +8, or a seeded 0x48 byte error record
block rules: tag 0x2e writes only byte 0, any other tag a seeded 0x48 byte record
signature recovery: tag 0 plus a planned 20 byte address, or tag 1 plus a boxed error
signing digest: SHA-256 of the variant word and the message content, written as 32 bytes
nested certificate wrapper 0x595fd20: seeded record, 0x2e or another tag
drop of the block certificates, recorded
B-tree into-iter step: writes 1 while the length word at +0x40 is non-zero and decrements it
bump allocator with 0xa5 fill, optional failure of the first call
allocation error handler: records and stops
sized free: records pointer, size, flags
